mathematical_counterexamples.description: Deterministic counterexample to 'median non-additivity implies bimodality': X, Z independent Exp(1), Y = X + Z has joint density exp(-Y) on 0 <= X <= Y, which is unimodal (log-concave); median(X) = median(Y - X) = ln 2; median(Y) = m solves exp(-m)(1+m) = 1/2; the non-additivity 2*ln2 - m is nonzero. Synthetic mathematical illustration, not a model of LePhare's posterior; no sampled data is used.
